scope: Forecast-admissible background clocks applied symmetrically to uninhibited and inhibited arms on sealed S8, S04B, New Zealand and California EP+ inputs. No new histories and no sealed authority writes.

T2.role: training-centred and origin-clamped; zero future clock

T3.depletion: R(t,z) = G(t,z) - (c + k*x_clamp(t)); (c,k) OLS on the training event depletion field, frozen for test; the exposure-node projection is recorded as a sensitivity

DSTAR.role: conditional true-trend control; S8 only; T0-fitted (n, log c, p) held fixed in both arms

s8.fitting: T1/T2/T3: eight starts, archived shared/inhibition bounds, L-BFGS-B with a failure-only extended retry. T1 uses four shared and seven inhibited coordinates. DSTAR: three intercept starts and four (eta, log ell, log psi) starts with the T0 trigger nuisance fixed.
s8.scoring: Archived adaptive order-8/16 plan for selected states; fast 20/24 order-32 sensitivity. T0 replay against the sealed per-seed null and inhibited held-out scores.

s04b.fitting: Four starts: the archived T0 solution adapted to the law plus three protocol templates. Archived shared/inhibition bounds. L-BFGS-B, maxiter 100, failure-only extended retry.
s04b.scoring: Fast 20/24 order-32 plan for selected states. T0 comparator is the sealed per-case LI+ total gain.
s04b.primary_output: Regime-level held-out gain quantiles and the fate of the archived T0 negative tail.

nz.fitting: Archived per-fold trigger/stress kernels and productivity ratio fixed. T1 fits (a,n) and (a,n,eta); T2/T3 fit (a,d,n) and (a,d,n,eta). L-BFGS-B, order 32 predictive-history quadrature.
nz.primary_output: Three-fold shared-attenuation contrast totals and per-fold signed contrasts.

california.fitting: Null backbone refit under each law with frozen interior background weights and the fixed Sobol proposal. T1 fits seven coordinates, T2/T3 fit eight. Three starts.
california.attenuation_profile: Fixed (ell0, psi) grid (10,2), (20,5), (50,30) km/d; eta selected on the training profile; held-out total LI+ contrast at the selected eta.
california.primary_output: Per-fold EP+ joint gain versus the sealed original-EP score and same-proposal paired changes against T0.

guardrails.sealed_paths: validation/authorities/ and all pre-existing validation/live_results/ subdirectories
guardrails.paired_arms: The same background law is applied to the uninhibited and inhibited arms in every comparator.
